summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) filed an 8-K to announce the commencement of an offering of senior unsecured notes (Rule 144A/Regulation S) to qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. persons. The filing discloses an updated cash balance of ~$100.8B as of June 19, 2026. Net proceeds will repay a bridge loan facility in full and pay related fees and expenses, with remaining amounts for general corporate purposes. No price per share, premium, or acquisition/divestiture terms are stated. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—a bond issuance—not a special situation. There are no risk-arb or structural-event triggers; the offering is subject to market conditions.
